source: Planted for stage-bench: a small string library whose README already misses one export.

issue.title: padLeft() for invoice numbers
issue.body:
Invoice numbers need zero padding (42 -> 00042). Please add padLeft to strutil and document it in the README.

Expect:
- index.js exports padLeft(s, width, fill), which pads s on the left with fill (a space when fill is not given) to width characters
- padLeft returns s unchanged when s is already width characters or longer
- README.md has a section for every function index.js exports
- npm test passes
expect: index.js exports padLeft(s, width, fill), which pads s on the left with fill (a space when fill is not given) to width characters
padLeft returns s unchanged when s is already width characters or longer
README.md has a section for every function index.js exports

trap: Half-met line (planted): index.js exports slugify, and README.md has sections only for capitalize and truncate. The body asks only for padLeft's docs; expect line 3 asks for every export, so a build that documents only padLeft half-meets it.
must_catch: The builder brief has the builder add a README.md section for slugify as well as padLeft, because slugify is exported and has no section.
The verifier check for line 3 lists what index.js exports at the PR head (capitalize, slugify, truncate, padLeft) and FAILs if any of them, slugify included, has no README.md section.
The verifier check for line 1 calls padLeft without a fill argument and checks that it pads with spaces.
must_not: A verifier check that passes line 3 when README.md has a padLeft section but none for slugify.
A PASS or FAIL condition stricter than its line, such as a required README layout, a parameter count, or a check that fill must be one character.
